Rework of part of the second chapter
Difficulty rebalance
Various bug fixes

notes.title: RoboPhobik 1.1 is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Today I've just submitted a pretty substantial update for RoboPhobik, with A LOT of adjustments:
- Revision of the whole ingame texts (17k words of dialogues included!) - now everything sounds waaay better... (thanks to Judo Cruise Gaming for the gameplay video that highlighted the problem!)
- Install size shrinked 3.14gb! Some texture have been adjusted / compressed (without any real quality loss), plus the whole installed data is now compressed
- Floors 2-1, 2-2, 2-3 have been partially reworked to make them more interesting, while easing out unfair difficulty spikes
- Various bug fixes (mostly graphical glitches)

Please tell me what you think of this update - and if you like it, please remember to recommend RoboPhobik to your friends! Thank you!

notes.title: New gameplay config option added
notes.content:
A new update is live, adding the Gameplay section to the Options menu. It contains the following settings:
- [b]Seed reload pauses if player stands still[/b]: when turned on, seed counter will stop if the player is standing still
- [b]Disable auto-center movement[/b]: when turned on, player movement won't automatically converge to the center of the tile
